_comment: DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- this example file is NEVER loaded or seeded.
To ship org defaults: copy this file to defaults.local.json next to
Wrapp.exe and fill in real values. defaults.local.json is gitignored
and never committed; your internal release pipeline should drop it
into the publish folder.
SEEDING SEMANTICS: tenants/sites/domains seed whenever the matching
settings section is empty. Everything else (Vault, Endpoint, the
*Defaults blocks) seeds ONCE per user profile, on the first launch
that sees the file, and only into fields still at factory defaults --
a technician's own settings are never overwritten. Ship the file WITH
the app so it is present at first launch.
SensitivePatterns are case-insensitive regexes scrubbed from every
log line (shown as ***ORG-REDACTED***) -- list tenant GUIDs, server
names, and internal domains here.
NOT seedable by design: client secrets (DPAPI per-user -- technicians
paste once, or use AuthFlow ClientCert with a deployed certificate),
the key-vault URL trust approval (each technician approves the
vault URL once even when it is pre-filled here), and the update-feed
trust approval (Update.FeedUrl pre-fills, but each technician approves
it once before any update is fetched -- updates are executable code).
Org TEMPLATES are a separate mechanism: put .ps1/.json files in an
org-templates\ folder next to Wrapp.exe, mirroring the Templates
layout (Scripts\Install, Scripts\Uninstall, Scripts\PSADT,
Packages\Intune, Packages\SCCM, Assignments, Deployments). They ship
into each profile like built-ins: protected in the pickers, refreshed
on pack updates unless the technician edited their copy.
